name: codex-orchestration
description: Classifier-only Terra orchestration with root-owned coordination.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.9.0 gives the GPT-5.6 Terra / Max orchestrator one job: read the current query plus bounded conversational continuity, classify it into the existing taxonomy, return the route to root, and stop. It receives no workspace dependency data or task-specific instructions and never researches, implements, supervises, spawns, or coordinates. Root mechanically starts the selected supervisor and implementer, relays serial checkpoints, performs root-only experience observations, and returns the supervisor's exact readable report. Terra / Max remains independently available as an implementer and as a supervisor. Ordinary read-only follow-ups still use the direct root fast path. Root loads the bundled artifact runtime only after classification and passes it directly to task roles for spreadsheet, presentation, document, and PDF work. Bounded completion capsules and recent conversation preserve continuity without replaying a completed rollout. Seven conflict-safe companion profiles preserve the classifier, three implementation lanes, three supervisor lanes, fixed routing, and readable milestone output.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat tweak/build routing with checkpoint supervision.
